stories.title: You can’t ignore Google Zero anymore
stories.author: David Pierce
bullet_points: The traditional symbiotic relationship between Google (data collection/indexing) and websites (traffic) is reportedly ending.
This shift signals a fundamental change in how the web economy operates and how Google monetizes its indexing power.
The article suggests the existing 'deal' was inherently unbalanced, favoring Google's revenue over website compensation.

stories.title: This is the world's most advanced robotic servicing satellite—that we know about
stories.author: Stephen Clark
bullet_points: The article discusses a highly advanced robotic servicing satellite.
The technology represents a significant achievement in complex space engineering.
The development addresses notoriously difficult challenges in space operations.

stories.title: 3D-Aware VLMs with Implicit and Explicit Geometries
stories.author: Gongjie Zhang
bullet_points: Addresses a key limitation in current 2D Vision-Language Models (VLMs) regarding 3D spatial understanding.
Introduces VLM-IE3D, a unified framework that integrates both implicit and explicit 3D geometries from RGB videos.
Utilizes novel Implicit Geometry Tokens (IGTs) to embed high-level geometric priors into the VLM architecture.

stories.title: GraphVid: Interactive Graph-Controllable Video Generation
stories.author: Ismini Lourentzou
bullet_points: GraphVid addresses the challenge of precise multi-object interaction control in video generation.
It overcomes limitations of text prompts and trajectory-based inputs that struggle with complexity and occlusion.
The method utilizes a graph-based approach to enable flexible and precise control over multiple subjects in video generation.

stories.title: OpenForgeRL: Train Harness-native Agents in Any Environment
stories.author: Jianfeng Gao
bullet_points: Introduces OpenForgeRL, an open-source framework designed to train AI agents end-to-end.
Addresses the challenge of training agents that rely on complex, proprietary inference harnesses (like Claude Code/Codex) within open infrastructure.
Enables the native expression of stateful, multi-process harness inference during the training process.

stories.title: 3D-Aware VLMs with Implicit and Explicit Geometries
stories.author: Gongjie Zhang
bullet_points: Addresses the limitation of 2D Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in handling complex 3D spatial reasoning tasks.
Introduces VLM-IE3D, a unified framework that integrates both implicit and explicit 3D geometries derived from RGB videos.
Employs Implicit Geometry Tokens (IGTs) to enhance the 3D spatial awareness capabilities of existing VLMs.

stories.title: X$^3$-OPD: Distilling Reasoning into Large Audio-Language Models via On-Policy Alignment
stories.author: Tao Jin
bullet_points: Addresses the gap in deep logical reasoning capabilities of large audio-language models compared to text-based LLMs.
Introduces X$^3$-OPD, a cross-modal on-policy distillation framework.
The framework transfers advanced reasoning skills from a powerful text teacher model to an audio-language student model.

stories.title: DONDO: Open w2v-BERT Speech-Recognition Base Models for African Languages
stories.author: Paul Azunre
bullet_points: Introduction of DONDO, a family of open, permissively licensed ASR base models specifically for African languages.
The models utilize the w2v-BERT 2.0 self-supervised speech encoder and cover 27 language varieties across several African nations.
Training data primarily consists of read speech from religious texts, ensuring broad and license-clear usage.

stories.title: Windowed-MTP: Removing the Full-Context Draft-KV Tax at Million-Token Context
stories.author: Alagappan Valliappan
bullet_points: The paper addresses a critical scalability issue in speculative decoding when using Multi-Token-Prediction (MTP) draft heads.
At very large context windows (million tokens), the MTP draft head's full attention over the KV cache becomes computationally prohibitive.
The proposed 'Windowed-MTP' method aims to mitigate this linear growth in draft cost, enabling efficient generation at massive context lengths.

stories.title: Claude Opus 5

stories.title: After backlash, Meta pauses plan to ‘rate limit’ its smart glasses
stories.author: Sean Hollister
bullet_points: Meta has paused its plan to charge a subscription fee for a smart glasses feature.
The feature in question allows users to hear each other more clearly.
The functionality operates locally on the glasses and does not require cloud processing.

stories.title: Meta just created a moderation nightmare for its smart glasses
stories.author: Mia Sato
bullet_points: Meta's smart glasses are facing significant public backlash regarding privacy concerns.
The devices are being misused by bad actors to film unsuspecting strangers, including women.
The situation presents a major public relations and moderation challenge for Meta.

stories.title: Qualcomm is about to raise prices and that’s bad news for everyone
stories.author: Stevie Bonifield
bullet_points: Qualcomm plans to implement significant price increases, reportedly in the double digits.
The price hikes are scheduled to take effect for products shipped after September 1st.
The company attributes the necessary increases to being unable to absorb higher costs from suppliers due to ongoing component shortages.

stories.title: Anthropic's Opus 5 is about token efficiency, not a capability leap
stories.author: Samuel Axon
bullet_points: Anthropic's Opus 5 update emphasizes token efficiency over massive capability jumps.
The article suggests that current, more cost-effective models are often sufficient for practical applications.
This points to a trend where optimization and efficiency are becoming as critical as raw performance in LLM development.

stories.title: Roku raises streaming stick prices by up to 60 percent
stories.author: Scharon Harding
bullet_points: Roku is significantly increasing the price of its streaming sticks by up to 60%.
The company attributes the price hike to a shortage of RAM.
The announcement contrasts with positive business outlooks previously shared by the CEO.

stories.title: Beyond Sufficiency: Time Series Explanation with Counterfactual Necessity
stories.author: Weiru Liu
bullet_points: Introduces TimePNS, a new framework for explaining time-series classifiers.
Addresses a limitation in current methods by incorporating 'necessity' alongside 'sufficiency' in explanations.
Aims to prevent spurious subsequences from being over-weighted in model explanations, aligning with counterfactual reasoning.

stories.title: Beyond Sycophancy: Structured Resistance and Compliance in LLM Moral Reasoning
stories.author: Bernard Koch
bullet_points: The research addresses the limitations of simply reducing sycophancy in LLMs, suggesting a more nuanced approach is needed.
The study focuses on developing socially calibrated LLMs capable of discerning when to accept external input versus maintaining independent moral judgment.
Model judgment revision is shown to be structured across three dimensions related to the resistance-compliance process.

stories.title: MIRROR: Learning from the Other View for Multi-Modal Reasoning
stories.author: Xuezhe Ma
bullet_points: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) show inconsistent performance in visual reasoning, even when multiple input views (text, diagram, combined) are available.
The study, MIRROR, suggests that different input views expose complementary, yet sometimes conflicting, reasoning capabilities within VLMs.
This highlights a key limitation in current multimodal AI, where success in one modality (e.g., text) does not guarantee success in another (e.g., visual diagrams).

stories.title: Expanding Flow Maps
stories.author: Pranam Chatterjee
bullet_points: Introduces Expanding Generative Flows (EFlows) to address limitations in existing flow-based generative models.
EFlows allow for generation across distributions of increasing dimensionality by augmenting the state with conditional noise.
The research aims to overcome constraints related to fixed dimensions or fixed sequence lengths in current generative models.

stories.title: Beyond Sufficiency: Time Series Explanation with Counterfactual Necessity
stories.author: Weiru Liu
bullet_points: Introduces TimePNS, a new framework for explaining time-series classifiers.
Addresses a limitation in existing methods by incorporating 'necessity' alongside 'sufficiency' in explanations.
Aims to prevent spurious subsequences from receiving high importance in model explanations.

stories.title: MIRROR: Learning from the Other View for Multi-Modal Reasoning
stories.author: Xuezhe Ma
bullet_points: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) show inconsistent performance in visual reasoning, even when multiple input views (text, diagram, combined) are available.
The study, MIRROR, suggests that different input views expose complementary, yet sometimes conflicting, reasoning capabilities within VLMs.
This highlights a key weakness in current VLMs: the inability to robustly transfer reasoning across different modalities (text vs. visual).

stories.title: The Boundaries of Automation: A Theory of Persistent Human Participation
stories.author: Iryna Gurevych
bullet_points: Challenges the prevailing assumption that human involvement in AI is solely due to current system limitations.
Proposes a theoretical framework to define the conceptual boundaries of automation.
Argues that human participation may persist even when AI systems achieve high levels of capability.

stories.title: MedGame: Storytelling Gamification Empowered by Large Language Models for Medical Education
stories.author: Qi Dou
bullet_points: Introduces MedGame, a framework to gamify medical education using LLMs.
Addresses a gap in current LLM medical tools by moving beyond single-turn Q&A to full decision-centered learning trajectories.
Employs a dual-engine design, including a Medical Narrative Designer, to transform static clinical cases into interactive games.

stories.title: OpenForgeRL: Train Harness-native Agents in Any Environment
stories.author: Jianfeng Gao
bullet_points: OpenForgeRL is a new open-source framework designed to train AI agents end-to-end.
It addresses the difficulty of training agents that rely on complex, proprietary inference harnesses (like Claude Code/Codex) within open infrastructure.
The framework enables the native expression of stateful, multi-process harness inference for diverse environments.

stories.title: GS-Agent: Creating 4D Physical Worlds With Generative Simulation
stories.author: Chuang Gan
bullet_points: The research addresses the challenge of generating physically realistic 4D worlds (space + time) from natural language prompts.
It aims to overcome limitations in existing generative models regarding physical plausibility and controllability.
The work leverages advances in generative foundation models to automate the creation of complex simulations previously requiring manual effort.

stories.title: Artificial Epanorthosis: Why large language models overuse a classical rhetorical figure, and how to mitigate it
stories.author: Federico Boggia
bullet_points: LLMs exhibit a systematic overuse of 'epanorthosis,' a classical rhetorical self-correction figure.
The overuse is attributed to training data rich in promotional prose and RLHF rewarding confident phrasing.
The paper suggests the left-to-right nature of LLM generation contributes to this rhetorical pattern.

stories.title: What, Where, and How: Disentangling the Roles of Task, Language, and Model in Code Model Representations
stories.author: Piotr Wilam
bullet_points: The research investigates how different language models (Qwen2.5-Coder-7B vs. DeepSeek-Coder-V1-6.7B) represent code concepts across different programming languages (Python vs. Rust).
It uses a 2x2 design to disentangle whether code representations depend on the specific task, the language used, or the underlying model architecture.
The study measures a comprehensive inventory of grammatical concepts (58 for Python, 57 for Rust) to analyze representation consistency.

stories.title: Agentic coding without the cloud: evaluating open-weight large language models on longitudinal data preparation tasks
stories.author: David Bann
bullet_points: Addresses the privacy constraint of using cloud-based LLMs for code development, especially with sensitive data.
Proposes using locally deployable, open-weight LLMs as a solution to keep data within the local environment.
Introduces an open-source framework to evaluate the performance of AI agents on longitudinal data preparation tasks.

stories.title: Android May Soon Restrict On-Device ADB
stories.author: shscs911
bullet_points: Android is reportedly considering restrictions on On-Device ADB (Android Debug Bridge).
This change suggests a potential tightening of developer access and debugging capabilities on Android devices.
The move signals a trend towards increased platform security and sandboxing within the Android ecosystem.

stories.title: India's first privately-developed rocket reaches orbit on debut launch
stories.author: sohkamyung
bullet_points: India achieved a significant milestone with its first privately-developed rocket reaching orbit.
The launch marks a key development in the growth of the private space industry in India.
The success highlights increasing domestic technological capability in aerospace.
